scope: Independent read-only GitHub Actions replay of frozen financial BP and recurrent V1 BPTT interfaces; does not replace or weaken existing quality gates.

frozen_contracts.binary_policy: Existing sealed Linux x86_64 recovered.so is loaded directly. An ABI or loader failure remains a failure; no rebuild, substituted implementation or new identity.

permissions_and_failure_semantics.trigger: workflow_dispatch or pull_request touching only the workflow or three financial/adapter/recurrent directories
permissions_and_failure_semantics.source_writes: forbidden by final tracked/staged/untracked cleanliness check
permissions_and_failure_semantics.output_location: Fresh RUNNER_TEMP directory; all five result output filenames are distinct and create-only
permissions_and_failure_semantics.errors: Four scripts return exit zero only on their gates; the independent checker raises on rejection. No continue-on-error. Always-run later steps and artifact upload do not erase earlier failures.
permissions_and_failure_semantics.artifact_upload: Always after noncancelled execution; includes setup metadata and any complete or failed result records.
permissions_and_failure_semantics.cancellation: A cancelled job is not a pass.

just_fmt.output: No changed files need formatting. Use --all for a full repository check.
just_fmt.interpretation: Actual repository recipe executed. Its scoped formatter does not select YAML; the separate real pinned Prettier check is the YAML formatting evidence.

local_verification.overwrite_and_wrong_identity_controls: Both reject, retaining existing source-bindings bytes.
local_verification.create_only_writers: Source-extracted exact write/sha functions from adapter_common.py and recurrent_common.py each tested for successful first write, rejected overwrite, and rejected nonfinite JSON; no financial code imported.

independent_review.result: No blocking wiring or security finding
observations: Only contents:read; no secrets, write tokens or pull_request_target.
Exact-head checkout and sparse paths cover all 25 protocol-sealed source entries verified by reviewer (7 adapter, 7 recurrent, 11 financial recovery).
All four actual audit/training argparse contracts match workflow parameters; result checker wiring is also present.
Distinct create-only result paths, strict shell status and absence of continue-on-error preserve failures.
Final tracked/staged/untracked source check is compatible with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE.
independent_review.scope: Read-only source and identity review; no new numerical, Torch, native or remote execution.

limitations: This workflow has not yet run on GitHub Actions; no remote pass is claimed.
Actual PyTorch package availability and Linux runner shared-library ABI compatibility must be established by the new head run.
The lane replays already-opened functional fixtures. It does not create a new scientific confirmation set or establish accuracy outside frozen numerical domains.
Recurrent V1 uses independently supplied signed x. It is preserved as V1; a later fixed-asset/log-V candidate requires its own frozen protocol and explicit additional workflow wiring.
The result checker recomputes record/count/FP32 Euler/temporal adjoint/loss/update consistency. It neither reexecutes Adam nor replaces the frozen financial reference validation.

installation_notes.initial_configuration_failure: Using /dev/null for both npm user/global config was rejected as duplicate loading; distinct empty task-local configs corrected that setup.
installation_notes.default_network_failure: Official registry request was denied by sandbox connect EPERM.
installation_notes.approved_retry: The same install was retried through require_escalated automatic review and completed exit zero. Install scripts were disabled; no repository dependencies or lockfiles changed.
